scenes.audio: 15,000 followers, 90 days. And if not, back to the 9 to 5. Here's how we're going to do it.

She wears a black tank top and gold jewelry, including a necklace and rings. She holds a small black Rode wireless microphone in her right hand close to her mouth. The background is a soft-lit indoor setting with a green plant and a staircase. The lighting is soft and neutral.

scenes.audio: If you're also trying to be the next 'it' girl and you want to grow on your platforms, you're in the right spot.

scenes.audio: Number one, and I know everybody's tired of hearing this, but consistency really is key.

scenes.visual: She raises her left index finger to emphasize the first point while still holding the microphone in her right hand. Her expression is serious but engaging.

scenes.audio: But we're focusing on quantity without risking the quality.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: She opens her left hand, palm facing the viewer, and moves it side-to-side to denote balance. She continues to hold the microphone steady.

scenes.audio: I want y'all to be so damn tired of seeing my face.

scenes.audio: I want you to see me on your feed and think, 'damn, again?!'

scenes.visual: She points her left index finger directly at the camera while speaking, highlighting the intended audience reaction.

scenes.audio: You need to get people so used to seeing your face to the point where they're thinking, 'Oh, I wonder what she is doing next.'

scenes.visual: She moves her left hand in fluid motions while explaining her strategy, looking slightly to the side before returning her gaze to the lens.

scenes.audio: Ingrain yourself in their brain so that they cannot forget. Baby, I live in your hippocampus now.

scenes.visual: She taps her temple with her left index finger, emphasizing the mental impact of her strategy. The microphone remains in her right hand.

scenes.audio: What's the hippocampus? The hippocampus is a part of the brain that is primarily associated with memory.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The video switches to a black and white color grade. The woman looks down at a white smartphone in her hands, appearing to scroll through information.

scenes.audio: There you go. Number two, SEO.

scenes.visual: The color returns to normal. She snaps the fingers of her left hand and points toward the camera as she introduces the next point.

scenes.audio: If you don't know, it stands for search engine optimization.

scenes.audio: What's the point of good content if nobody can find it?

scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: She holds up three fingers on her left hand and then gives a thumbs-up gesture as she introduces the third strategy point.

scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: The camera zooms in closer to her face as she speaks candidly, highlighting her directness and sincerity.

scenes.audio: ...all the successes, the failures, exactly what works and what doesn't work for me so that you guys can apply this to your growth strategy.
scenes.label: Real Experience
scenes.visual: She continues speaking, moving her left hand in a sweeping motion as she lists various aspects of her content journey.

scenes.audio: I'll be updating you guys every week on exactly what's working, what I'm trying, what needs to be fixed, and what I'm learning along the way so that you guys can go and apply this to your content.

scenes.visual: She speaks about the future of her channel, using both hands to illustrate consistency and the iterative process of learning.

scenes.audio: And with that, I'll see you in the next video. Go be great and I'll catch you on the flip.

scenes.visual: She smiles broadly, points her finger at the camera, and then waves her hand in a relaxed 'see you later' gesture to close the video.
